feed.title: UK News - The latest headlines from the UK | Sky News

articles.title: Suspects accused of vandalising Trump Turnberry golf resort to stand trial
articles.summary: A group of suspects charged with maliciously damaging a Scottish golf course owned by US President Donald Trump - an alleged offence prosecutors will argue had a "terrorist connection" - will stand trial in 2028.

articles.title: Paedophile who sexually abused infant and incited rape of another child jailed
articles.summary: A paedophile who sexually abused an infant and incited the rape of another child has been jailed for 10-and-a-half years.

articles.title: UK set for calmer weather - but 'dense' fog may cause disruption
articles.summary: The UK is set for a period of calmer weather after three people died during storms over the weekend - but "dense" fog could cause further disruption.

articles.title: US embassy worker flown out of UK before police questioning
articles.summary: A senior US Air Force officer was flown out of the UK before he could be questioned over allegations that he possessed child sexual abuse images, it has emerged.

articles.title: Woman dies in sea off Isle of Wight - as search suspended for man in Scotland
articles.summary: A woman has died in the sea off the Isle of Wight, while the search for a man swept into the sea in Scotland by large waves has been suspended.

articles.title: Poundland close to collapse as new directors head for exit
articles.summary: The directors recruited to steer Poundland through its emergency sale process less than two weeks ago are on the brink of resigning, heightening the risk that one of Britain's biggest discount retailers will collapse within days, risking thousands of job losse

articles.title: Debate unfolds over removal of mummified Egyptian remains from two museums
articles.summary: The removal of mummified Egyptian remains from display at two Glasgow museums has sparked a lively debate - is it "woke madness" or the decent and "ethical" thing to do?
